name: Tetratron Upgrade
body:
Prerequisite(s): Bitron Upgrade, character level 8th, must be acquired at the “Cube”

Benefit(s): Your form becomes that of the Tetratron. Your natural AC bonus increases to +4, and you lose your Melee Damage Vulnerability racial feature.

Lastly you gain 1 bonus hit point per character level.

Special: You cannot have both the Trinitron upgrade and the Tetratron upgrade, you must choose one or the other.
